discussion_comments.comment_body:
We should not expose an "email" does exist endpoint. It is a security issue.

If you remove this but keep the other error messages I think this will be good

thanks,

- The code no longer checks if the user exists in the app DB before attempting to provision them in Better Auth.
- On sign-in, if the user does not exist in Better Auth, the code tries to create them in Better Auth (using the provided password).
- If the user already exists in Better Auth, it tries to sign in.
- If the user exists in the app DB but not in Better Auth, the provisioning step will still run, but only if the sign-in fails.
hql_user should require a password - since the user itself can access all org data
I also think this isn't entirely sufficient on its own, it should be paired with another rate limit or some kind of authz check (tier? RBAC?)
updated the rate limits for this
